## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector weakness (9/11 sectors negative) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.94%) alongside muted VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -11.47%) — market direction unclear.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity strength driving pockets of risk appetite: BNO (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +23.01%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND are supportive. Credit and volatility neutral: HYG (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -0.07%) BELOW TREND and VXX (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -11.47%) BELOW TREND — overall neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -0.30%) suggesting slight yield pressure while dollar and curve readouts are flat (Dollar NEUTRAL | Yield Curve NEUTRAL).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing short-term strength: (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +1.09%) — defensive/commodity mix. Tech lagging but bouncing: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -0.05%); Consumer Discretionary weakening: XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -4.90%).

**5. US vs Global?**
US soft: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.94%); EM outperformance led by EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +4.86%); China weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -3.23%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto and innovation mixed: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.63% | 1M: +20.63%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +8.37%); small caps recovering: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -2.28%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity rally: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +23.78%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +23.01%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.68%) — inflation-sensitive sectors benefiting. Precious metals cooling: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +0.31%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +3.25%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong and broad: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.64%) with oil ETFs USO/BNO leading; natural gas mixed: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +7.39%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and EM (EEM ABOVE TREND) show consistent 1W/1M strength. DIVERGENCE: broad sector breadth weak (2/11) versus strong commodity leadership → mixed signals, treat as range-bound/transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy/commodity cyclicals (XLE, BNO) and select EM (EEM) given current drivers; reduce exposure to discretionary/healthcare downside areas (XLY BELOW TREND, XLV CORRECTION) while monitoring volatility and credit spreads.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND and Healthcare — XLV (1W: -2.00% | 1M: +0.88%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — BNO (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +23.01%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold — GLD (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +0.31%) CORRECTION, watch for further downside on risk-on flows.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, broad sector weakness offsets commodity-led pockets of strength. Energy and select EM showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND; EEM ABOVE TREND) while weak breadth and discretionary/health divergences are the key risks to monitor.
